direction: testing owner supplies read-only frames; model line consumes them. This component does not acquire, schedule, install or control

frame.native_ref: original run/ref, retain raw line and source export SHA in archive
frame.epoch: original source epoch; no resets at request/workblock boundaries
frame.arrival_host: actual receiver host, e.g. N305; not automatically Thor
frame.arrival_clock_id: one actual receiver monotonic clock identity; missing means arrival-side unavailable
frame.arrival_mono_s: actual receive/read-complete on receiver clock, never source file copy time
frame.arrived_at_utc: separately measured receiver UTC, no curve-based cross-host alignment
frame.source_only: true if no real contemporaneous receiver arrival; preserve file but no timely result
frame.all_core_values: retain original core ids/online/usage/frequency or raw CPU counters in source_original/reference; maximum may change core each sample

per_feature.value: original numeric value, independent rails in W, CPU/GPU in percent; null remains missing
per_feature.available_at_mono_s: only after actual receiver arrival; same clock as frame
per_feature.valid_until_mono_s: original eligibility support bound mapped by an evidenced clock relation; never refresh an old source identity or change production TTL
per_feature.valid: original source eligibility, independent of activity or fan safety permission
per_feature.update_id: identity of this source update, not its numeric value or repeated read call count
per_feature.source_order: monotone source sequence when known; null when not available
per_feature.feature_source: actual backend/field, unknown backend explicitly unknown
per_feature.source_sample_mono_s/source_read_start_m: Thor timestamps on identified source clock, unknowns null
per_feature.window_start_mono_s/window_end_mono_s/so: actual metric window/evidence; querying every200ms does not establish it
per_feature.age_lower_bound_ms/age_at_source_receive: separate source age, receiver support and transport; unknown transport is null, not0
per_feature.update_evidence: raw counter/window/sequence/backend evidence; equal values may be fresh, new read of same buffer is not a new independent sample
per_feature.original_ref/original_seq/raw_unit/unkno: retain original reference, source ordering, raw units and unresolved items

thermal_origin.source: unchanged native approximately1s accepted/eligible origin, no high-frequency TJ creation
thermal_origin.rule: same original observer state at this origin and real current TJ; no new activity correction of state, boundary or theta. PWM and its qualification/provenance belong to original observer, never generated by activity
thermal_origin.labels: all original qualified TJ records and source identity retained; evaluation does per-horizon lookup independently

actual_event_optional.done_mono_s: actual client protocol_DONE or null; never presumed GPU end
actual_event_optional.continuous_group: optional actual workload grouping for repeated-trigger description, not a feature or independent episode
actual_event_optional.purpose: reference for offline activity diagnosis only. No future schedule, planned end or request state is consumed by this candidate

cadence.actual: all actually arrived frames, same times for BASE/MEAN/CORE
cadence.causal_1s: at integer receiver-monotonic seconds select last already-arrived frame; emit at that second, retain original arrival and deadlines. Never use later frame or renew its support
cadence.comparison: report own coverage and common origins/labels across cadence conditions; difference in actual effective source rate must be supported by source evidence
cadence.unverified: source-only or unknown clock/window results cannot certify millisecond physical ordering

activity_memory_clarification: Frozen analysis-spec history_budget_s=3 describes the low-confirmation timer. Actual implementation retains one hysteresis state bit while valid observations remain in the intermediate band; it is not a hard3s forgetting window. All variants have the same bit/timer and original feature deadlines. This clarification changes no candidate parameter or score.

registration.run_id: actual new run or explicitly synthetic identifier; one thermal history
registration.candidate_sha256/analysis_spec_sha256: bind this frozen proposal before new inspection
registration.declared_role: targeted frozen check / development exploration / synthetic only; not cross-device final generalization
registration.saw_new_data_for_parameter_selection: if true evaluator forces development_exploration; declaration is not evidence that a threshold was actually frozen

consumer.file: consume.py replay --input FRAMES.jsonl --output NEW.jsonl (offline, actual code)
consumer.loopback: consume.py serve --allow-loopback-service --port0 --duration-s60; explicit opt-in, actual receiver stamps time; producer same-boot monotonic declaration needed, otherwise unknown
consumer.field: no device address or outbound request implementation. Future testing owner may call Processor directly in its authorised diagnostic path; this is not installation or field permission
